artifacts.angle: Explain why human neurology over-values immediate small rewards over massive future gains (choosing $50 today over $100 next year). Show how this bias quietly destroys compound growth in retirement accounts over a 30-year horizon. Counter-move: pre-commitment mechanisms that lock future income straight into investment vehicles.
artifacts.hook: Your brain is hardwired to choose $50 right now over $500 next year—and banks profit millions off it.
